description: Create a scheduled change monitor for one public URL: the server re-fetches the page on an interval, stores a new snapshot and records a diff event whenever the readable text changes. When to use: the user wants to be told when a page changes (price, docs, policy page, job post, release notes) and cannot poll it themselves; also for handing off 'watch this for me'. Do not use: for a single comparison right now (web_diff) or when you only need the page today (web_fetch). Returns: {ok, monitor_id, url, status:active, interval_minutes, next_check_ts, webhook_enabled, webhook_secret?, webhook_signature?, hint}. The first check runs within ~60s to store the baseline; later changes show up in web_monitor_list.recent_events and, if requested, are POSTed to webhook_url. Webhook: https only, no redirects, 8s timeout, up to 2 retries (30s/120s); body JSON {monitor_id,url,ts,changed,added_lines,removed_lines,title,diff,event_id}; verify header 'X-RobotBase-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using webhook_secret>'. Limits: 15-1440 minutes; max 5 monitors per IP; monitors expire after 7 days. Metered: 1 credit (shares the web free bucket of 100 calls/day per IP).

url.description: The http(s) URL to watch (max 2048 chars).

webhook_url.description: Optional https endpoint notified on each change (HMAC-signed).
